The '''Rescue of Sullustan Tech Staff''' took place during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Background==
Imperial stormtroopers kidnapped a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] technical staff, in what appeared to have been part of [[Operation Strike Fear]], possible planned invasion of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="X-wing" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] mounted a rescue mission to both return the staff and convince the Sullustans of the intentions of the Empire. Alliance has also hoped that this rescue will cause Sullustans to join the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="X-wing" />

==The Battle==
[[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] successfully identified and disabled the transports carrying the tech staff personnel. Next, to protect [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] ''Rescue'' Farlander went after [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] ''Zeta''. Staying close to the Transports to be able to provide cover. Once ''Alpha'' and ''Beta'' squadrons closed, he took out the leaders with torpedoes at range, then proceeded on to the wingmen with lasers.

Once ''Rescue'' finished rescuing the prisoners, all ships jumped to hyperspace.

==Aftermath==
In the aftermath of the operation, Sullustans have become sympathetic towards the Rebel Alliance and started their negotiations to join the Rebel Alliance.
